ItemID: 25; Title: 25; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for vocal harmony or seasonal music, and this does not clearly match that interest.
ItemID: Lead With Your Heart; Title: Lead With Your Heart; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its melodic vocal style appeals to me after The New Old Fashioned; this is the one I would try.
ItemID: Rock Symphonies; Title: Rock Symphonies; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Instrumental rock arrangements are less appealing right now than vocal performances.
ItemID: Stages; Title: Stages; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Polished theatrical vocals sound appealing, but I would pass this time.
ItemID: That's Christmas To Me; Title: That's Christmas To Me; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my Christmas listening history, but I am not choosing another holiday album right now.
ItemID: A New Standard; Title: A New Standard; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Vocal interpretations of standards could suit my taste, though I need more interest to choose it today.
ItemID: 2015 GRAMMY Nominees; Title: 2015 GRAMMY Nominees; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A broad compilation does not give me a clear reason to expect the vocal sound I want.
ItemID: Partners; Title: Partners; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Vocal duets appeal to me, but I would stick with my first choice this visit.
ItemID: Songs From The Silver Screen; Title: Songs From The Silver Screen; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Melodic film songs could fit my listening preferences, but I am only trying one album.
ItemID: 19; Title: 19; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Solo pop is less relevant to my current interest in harmony-focused vocal music.
